integrity: The analytic proof gives exact identities for all stated real parameters; finite verifier tests support reproducibility only. The RP-only expected-risk formula follows from existing volume-sampling theory. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two points; rank-three first-harmonic real circle kernel; unrestricted optimal real weights; expected squared worst-case RKHS error; restricted family of target densities, not samplewise or large-node dominance.
title: Sharp density-dependent reversal between two-node randomly pivoted Cholesky and iid kernel quadrature
